kaikki_vikisozluk.w: أنا الغريق فما خوفي من البلل
kaikki_vikisozluk.u: أنا الغريق فما خوفي من البلل
kaikki_vikisozluk.e: أَنَا ٱلْغَرِيقُ فَمَا خَوْفِي مِنَ ٱلْبَلَلِ • (ʔanā l-ḡarīqu famā ḵawfī mina l-balali)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: From a poem by the Abbasid-era Arab poet Al-Mutanabbi. Literally, “I'm drowning—why should I be afraid of getting wet!”.
s: “I'm drowning—why should I be afraid of getting wet!”
Literally, “I'm drowning—why should I be afraid of getting wet!”
g: the situation is so bad that the risk of its deteriorating even more has become irrelevant; to have nothing to lose
r: ʔanā l-ḡarīqu famā ḵawfī mina l-balali
